Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 9  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the birth dates of the directors. Jean Yarbrough was born on **August 22, 1900**, while Takhir Sabirov was born on **December 21, 1929**. The Planner reversed the directors’ birth dates, concluding that Takhir Sabirov was born earlier, when it was actually Jean Yarbrough. This led to the incorrect final answer that "The Last Night of Scheherazade" has the director born first, when the correct answer is "Leave It to Henry."
